headline: Interviewed candidates for K-8 STEM Coordinator in executive session; the minutes record no hiring decision.
summary: The board voted unanimously to go into executive session to interview and discuss candidates for K-8 STEM Coordinator. The minutes do not record a hiring decision or any other outcome.
